assessment.nobel_worthiness: Inflation and the quantum origin of cosmic structure supplied a compelling physical account of the early universe and made testable predictions central to modern cosmology.
assessment.attribution: Guth initiated inflation, Linde developed its viable modern forms, and Mukhanov established the quantum mechanism for primordial structure.
assessment.maturity: CMB and large-scale-structure observations strongly support the central framework after decades of scrutiny.
uncertainties: No direct primordial gravitational-wave signature has yet selected a specific inflationary realization.
Early conceptual credit is broader than three names.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Baryon acoustic oscillations transformed an early-universe relic into a robust standard ruler for charting cosmic expansion.
assessment.attribution: The listed scientists represent the decisive theoretical interpretation and major survey demonstrations, although the achievement rests on extensive collaborations.
assessment.maturity: Repeated surveys have made BAO a mature and exceptionally useful precision-cosmology method.
uncertainties: The division between foundational theoretical and survey credit needs careful expert examination.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Horizon-scale imaging of black holes is an extraordinary observational achievement that brings strong-gravity physics into direct view.
assessment.attribution: Falcke, Narayan and Doeleman capture key conceptual, theoretical and instrumental leadership, while the result was necessarily a large collaboration.
assessment.maturity: The M87 and Galactic-centre results, with independent analysis pipelines and follow-up observations, establish a durable achievement.
uncertainties: The image tests compact-object and accretion predictions more directly than it uniquely proves every aspect of a classical event horizon.
Collaboration credit is difficult to compress into three people.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: WMAP converted the cosmic microwave background into a precision probe of the universe's contents, geometry and primordial fluctuations.
assessment.attribution: Bennett and Page were central to the mission and Spergel to its cosmological interpretation; broader mission credit remains substantial.
assessment.maturity: Its conclusions have been extensively confirmed and refined by later measurements.
uncertainties: The result is part of a longer observational chain involving COBE and Planck.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Geometric phase and the Aharonov-Bohm effect revealed that quantum phase has physically measurable, globally nontrivial consequences across physics.
assessment.attribution: Berry and Aharonov are clear intellectual figureheads for the two linked effects, though associated co-discoverers and experimental confirmations require review.
assessment.maturity: Both phenomena are deeply established experimentally and conceptually, with wide consequences in quantum and condensed-matter physics.
uncertainties: The candidate combines two distinct discoveries with partially different histories of credit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cold dark matter and hierarchical formation provided the organizing framework for interpreting the growth of cosmic structure.
assessment.attribution: Faber, White and Rees made major formative contributions, but the framework emerged through a broad community and related observational evidence.
assessment.maturity: The large-scale framework has been highly successful over several decades.
uncertainties: The microscopic nature of dark matter remains unknown.
Small-scale tensions and diffuse historical attribution limit a clean prize formulation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The association of neutron-star mergers with kilonovae and heavy-element production is a major multi-messenger insight into cosmic chemical origins.
assessment.attribution: Metzger and Kasen supplied decisive theoretical groundwork and Berger important observational leadership, but the scientific and collaboration-wide credit is extensive.
assessment.maturity: The neutron-star merger observations gave striking confirmation of the basic picture.
uncertainties: The quantitative share of r-process production across astrophysical sites remains unsettled.
The candidate's credit boundaries need expert review.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Gauge-gravity duality is one of the most profound theoretical ideas in modern high-energy physics and has reshaped several fields.
assessment.attribution: Maldacena made the decisive explicit conjecture, building on essential antecedents from Polyakov, Witten and a wider string-theory community.
assessment.maturity: Its internal theoretical development and applications are extensive.
uncertainties: There is no direct empirical confirmation in nature of the duality as a description of our universe.
Its broad conceptual lineage makes attribution especially difficult.
